title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Install, configure, and maintain Linux operating systems (e.g., Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu).
* Monitor system performance and ensure availability and reliability.
* Perform regular system updates, patches, and kernel upgrades.
* Manage servers, file systems, user accounts, and access controls (ACLs).
* Managing and Troubleshooting Storage mountpoints like, NFS & SMB and Block Storages
* In-depth knowledge on Protocols like iSCSI, FC, NFS, SMB, HTTPS, FTP, WebDAV, S3, Etc.,
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network-related issues.
* Set up and maintain shell scripts for automation of routine tasks.
* Implement and manage backup and recovery strategies.
* Maintain system documentation and procedures.
* Ensure system security through firewalls, access controls, and regular audits.
* Work with development and DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Respond to system alerts and participate in on-call rotation for critical issues.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field—or 3-4 years of equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience as a Linux Administrator or similar role.
* Strong understanding of Linux-based operating systems and command-line tools.
* Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, KVM).
* Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python).
* Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus).
* Understanding of networking fundamentals and security best practices.

**Preferred:**

* Certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, or CompTIA Linux+.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Familiarity with Ansible, Puppet, or other configuration management tools.
* Experience with container technologies and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

License/Certification:

* RHCE (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: I.T. Systems Administrator- Husky (India) Chennai
description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment.

This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability.

Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.

This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems.
* Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers.
* Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Collaborate with Development, Data, BI, and DBA teams to identify and resolve database and application performance issues.
* Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Support Active Directory administration, authentication services, and Kerberos-related troubleshooting.
* Support and maintain virtualized environments primarily based on Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents.
* Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

**The following certifications are considered an asset:**

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Citrix certifications

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise applications and systems technologies in a complex, global environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications.
* Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX.
* Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments.
* Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments.
* Experience working within ITIL-based support processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar business systems and technologies.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, warehouse management, and other business-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Teamcenter, NX, CAD/PDM/PLM platforms, WMS, OFS, TDM, or comparable business systems is considered an asset.
* Experience with Azure, Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

**Key Competencies**

* Self-motivated and highly independent.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Continuous learning mindset.

**Success Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who combines strong enterprise application support, Microsoft SQL Server administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting skills. They are comfortable working in an environment consisting of both legacy and modern systems, can independently acquire expertise in unfamiliar technologies, and take ownership of ensuring the long-term stability, performance, and supportability of business-critical applications.

title: Enterprise Automation Specialist (Ansible/AWX/AAP)
description:

Full time

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

**Education Desired :**

Bachelor's Degree

**Enterprise Automation Specialist (Ansible/AWX/AAP) – 10-14 Yrs – Pune/Bangalore Location**

**About the Team**

The Enterprise Platform Engineering team is responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and resilient automation capabilities across global infrastructure environments. The team drives infrastructure modernization, operational excellence, and enterprise-wide automation adoption through industry-leading automation and DevOps practices.

**What You Will Be Doing**

  

* Lead the architecture, engineering, governance, and lifecycle management of **Ansible Automation Platform** (AAP), **AWX**, and enterprise automation solutions.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, and operational workflows.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and automation standards across enterprise platforms.
* Develop and maintain advanced automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting technologies.
* Integrate automation platforms with enterprise tools including ServiceNow, monitoring solutions, cloud platforms, infrastructure management systems, and REST APIs.
* Establish automation governance, coding standards, Git workflows, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and platform best practices.
* Lead platform upgrades, troubleshooting, performance tuning, resiliency improvements, and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Implement and manage security controls including RBAC, secrets management, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and operations teams to identify automation opportunities and drive modernization programs.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership on automation strategy, architecture, and operational excellence.
* Leverage AI and Copilot technologies to accelerate automation development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What You Bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Automation, or Systems Engineering.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Ansible, AWX, or Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform.
* Strong hands-on development experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, and Shell scripting.
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale automation initiatives and platform operations.
* Experience delivering large-scale infrastructure modernization and automation transformation programs.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, virtualization technologies, networking, and cloud infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation frameworks, and configuration management principles.
* Extensive experience designing, deploying, upgrading, operating, and troubleshooting enterprise-scale automation platforms.
* Strong proficiency with GitHub, Git branching strategies, code review processes, and CI/CD methodologies.
* Experience integrating automation solutions with REST APIs, ServiceNow, monitoring platforms, infrastructure tools, and cloud services.
* Experience implementing platform resiliency, observability, disaster recovery, security controls, RBAC, and secrets management solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and solution architecture capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools and Copilot technologies.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

  

* Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes administration experience.
* Terraform and Infrastructure as Code tooling expertise.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and DevOps toolchains.
* Knowledge of Observability platforms, Enterprise Monitoring, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and Platform Operations.
* Experience driving enterprise automation adoption and governance initiatives.
* Exposure to AI-assisted software engineering and automation enablement.

**Preferred Certifications**

  

* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation
* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
* Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate
* GitHub Foundations or GitHub Advanced Security Certification

**Added Bonus If You Have**

  

* Experience supporting large-scale financial services environments.
* Expertise in multi-cloud automation strategies.
* Experience building reusable automation frameworks and enterprise automation standards.

**What We Offer you**

At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer:

* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development
* Resources to contribute to your community
* Competitive salary and benefits

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
